**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 11 already delivers the preferred position on every material term of the TRANSITION rule:

- **11.1 (p0046)** — up to six months' transition assistance on any expiry or termination, at Customer's request, priced at the *expiring Order Form* rates (more favourable to us than the playbook's "then-current rates"), and expressly covering knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, and continued service at existing scope and service levels.
- **11.2 (p0047)** — return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format with metadata, plus an anti-hostage provision barring withholding over fee disputes.
- **11.3 (p0048)** — secure deletion after Customer confirms successful return, with written certification by an authorized officer and continued protection of any copy retained under Applicable Law.

Cross-checks: 10.1 preserves Customer Data rights and ties access cut-off to the end of the transition period; 16.5 expressly defers to Sections 11 and 15 for Customer Data, so the general return-or-destroy confidentiality mechanic does not undercut the exit rights. No walk-away triggers (no data return, or immediate deletion) appear anywhere in the document.
